title: Structured graph model for components and flows
description:
Implement structured canonical graph observations after the instance, cardinality, and flow rulings.

Components carry repo-local entity identity, asserted taxonomy type/subtype, optional asserted vendor, and evidence/derivation locations. Repeated same-subtype components remain distinct unless reviewed evidence groups them.

Flows carry typed source and target endpoint identities plus separate data categories and supporting provenance. Reporting distinguishes observation/topology detection, endpoint resolution, semantic classification, vendor resolution where asserted, and strict correctness over all asserted fields.

Graph precision uses reviewed packet/layer graph scope. Locationless or otherwise unscorable findings remain visible with explicit computability reasons rather than disappearing from precision.

Definition of done: structured graph matching can attribute partial failures without turning them into strict success, and it preserves entity cardinality across components and edges.
